core's parseYaml reads a plain scalar continued on the next line inside a flow sequence (`[1⏎2]` is `['1 2']`), as the YAML 1.2 spec allows; js-yaml 4, which v12 used, rejects it (`missed comma between flow collection entries`). core's parseYaml rejects a tab-indented plain scalar document (`tabs are not allowed for indentation`), where js-yaml 4, which v12 used, read it as text; v12 then ignored the non-mapping data. Only the generated tabs variant writes it (core YAML, not kanban; #453).
